new_categories.label: hold_atmosphere_sensor_readiness
new_categories.memory: Dry-cargo hold atmosphere-monitoring sensor readiness is distinct from ventilation/air-exchange readiness and from refrigerated-cargo environmental control.

new_categories.label: hold_coverage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Monitoring assurance can be localized to an affected hold or bounded cargo-space scope without retaining exact sensor count or placement.

new_categories.label: temperature_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Non-numeric temperature-indication confidence can be represented separately from sensor physical readiness without retaining actual values or limits.

new_categories.label: humidity_indication_confidence
new_categories.memory: Non-numeric humidity-indication confidence is distinct from temperature indication and does not retain actual humidity values or thresholds.

new_categories.label: measurement_validity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Measurement validity confidence is distinct from mere indication presence and can degrade without asserting an exact calibration error or test result.

new_categories.label: independent_cross_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from the primary monitoring channel without retaining exact instruments, methods or comparison values.

new_categories.label: condensation_risk_confidence
new_categories.memory: A qualitative condensation-risk confidence state can be distinct from raw temperature/humidity indication without retaining dew-point calculations, thresholds or cargo-specific decisions.

new_categories.label: monitoring_support_dependency_confidence
new_categories.memory: Power, data or other monitoring-support confidence can degrade separately from sensor readiness and delivered indication without retaining topology or exact support configuration.

new_categories.label: trend_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Continuity of a monitoring trend can degrade separately from a single present indication without retaining actual time series or numerical trend criteria.

new_categories.label: hold_atmosphere_monitoring_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: The monitoring service can move through available, degraded, restricted, isolated, under-verification and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to sensor function, hold coverage, temperature indication, humidity indication, validity, cross-check or support dependency.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Cargo-condition concern, ventilation adjustment, hold restriction, claims/rework or schedule effects do not prove a sensor, coverage, validity, condensation-risk or support root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_monitoring_restoration
new_categories.memory: Sensor recovery, support recovery, indication return, validity/cross-check verification, trend re-establishment and hold release can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: ventilation_vs_atmosphere_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P089 cargo-space ventilation/air exchange can change hold atmosphere but does not establish temperature/humidity sensing, indication or validity confidence.

useful_refinements.label: reefer_control_vs_dry_hold_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P090 refrigerated-cargo service includes controlled cargo environments but does not duplicate ordinary dry-cargo hold atmosphere-monitoring assurance.

useful_refinements.label: hvac_service_vs_cargo_hold_monitoring
useful_refinements.memory: P072 shipboard HVAC/thermal-management service may influence nearby spaces but does not establish delivered dry-cargo hold monitoring coverage or validity.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_dryness_vs_atmosphere_indication
useful_refinements.memory: P109 cleanliness/dryness preparation confidence is a physical preparation state and does not establish ongoing temperature/humidity measurement or condensation-risk monitoring confidence.

duplicates.label: generic_instrument_indication_validity_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic instrumentation readiness, indication-versus-validity and cross-check mechanics repeat prior monitoring families such as P103 and P105.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_degradation_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

negative_space: exact hold atmosphere sensor arrangements, counts, locations, ranges, values, thresholds, dew-point calculations, condensation criteria, alarm logic and current configuration

stop_reason: The bounded structural questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact sensor placement, values, thresholds, dew-point calculations, alarm logic, calibration/test methods, cargo-specific operating decisions, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold atmosphere-monitoring orientation/source-discovery output; not calibration, ventilation, cargo-care or response guidance and not proof of any exact sensor arrangement, value, threshold, alarm logic, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
